title: The bird on the second chair
logline: Eleven days before Christmas Eve's two chairs: the dock at dusk, the lawn chair, and a second folding chair beside it already, the bird sitting in it. Whoever the chair is for hasn't sat in it yet.

panels.composition: The dock at dusk with an old lawn chair and a folding chair set beside it facing the water, the small rainbow bird sitting on the folding chair's seat, string lights not yet lit on the shack.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a wooden dock at dusk with an old lawn chair and a folding chair set beside it facing the water, a small rainbow bird sitting on the folding chair's seat, unlit string lights on a shingle shack behind, no words
